EN0: public run/source mapping complete; matrix checks done (features identical across 20 libraries, 31,053 genes, 36 duplicate symbols, no reporter features, integer counts, no duplicate barcodes); availability ledger written; biological pool/pair/spatial identities unknown
EN1: source-inspired clustering run per experiment (CA2 igraph multilevel; seed 20260928; r=0.5/1.0/1.5 -> Exp1 13/20/25, Exp2 17/25/36 clusters). Outputs trials/continuation/EN1/. Not an author-label reproduction; no resolution selected on an outcome.
EN2: independent-gate composition and within-state pseudobulk genotype contrasts run (trials/continuation/EN2_5/). Il1r1 homozygous minus heterozygous: transition-gate fraction lower at both times in every cross-library comparison (primary -0.057 at 14 d, -0.123 at 84 d; thinned -0.007/-0.014); AT2-state fraction higher (+0.077/+0.244; agreement only at 84 d). Within AT2 and mixed states (>=30 cells, 2 libraries per side): Cd177 pseudobulk lower by ~4 log2 units at both times; AT1 identity lower (-0.5/-0.6); response and Nfkbia near zero at 14 d, modestly lower at 84 d. Transition-state within-state contrast unavailable (homozygous libraries hold 0-12 transition cells). Composition and conditional expression answer different questions; no causal mediation.
EN3: separated axes per library with a declared WT-baseline q90 threshold. Response-high fraction varies 3-52% across libraries and 2-3x between replicate libraries of the same condition (e.g. GSM7890835 0.52 vs GSM7890836 0.22); Nfkbia-high fraction is 2-15% and does not track response; within-library Spearman(response, Nfkbia) is 0.24-0.54 everywhere including WT baseline, so no library-specific feedback decoupling is visible. Snapshot RNA, not activity or duration.
EN4: 2-week oncogenic-tissue YFP minus the single Confetti-YFP baseline: Spp1 +3.3, Dlk1 +4.0, Cd177 +1.3, transition RNA +1.0, priming +1.7 log2 units; response +0.1, Nfkbia -0.7, cycling -0.2. Mutant RFP exceeds oncogenic YFP on Cd177 (+3.4), Areg (+2.0), cycling (+1.1), AT1 identity (+0.8). Single baseline library and unverified pairing; 4-day arm unavailable (no Confetti arm).
EN5: CD177 primary contrast available only in GSM7890835 (79 vs 799) and GSM7890836 (60 vs 598) at raw depth; no thinned variant retains an eligible group (transition gate collapses to 90/47 cells at 1,000 UMIs) and no Il1r1 or WT library qualifies. Cycling score, Cd177>=1 minus Cd177=0: GSM7890835 SMD -0.04 (matched -0.05, 4 strata, 63 vs 408); GSM7890836 SMD +0.48 (binary cycling fraction 0.47 vs 0.17; matched weighted SMD +0.19, 2 strata, 35 vs 111). Direction is library-dependent and shrinks under depth/hypoxia matching; >=2-UMI sensitivity gives the same picture. Consistent across both libraries and both cycling strata: Cd177+ transition cells show higher priming_associated (SMD 1.6-2.2), higher AT2 identity (0.9-1.4) and AT1 identity (0.5-0.85), lower Itga2 (-0.5 to -0.75) and lower shared/lesion disjoint modules (-0.7 to -1.2). Cd177+ cells are deeper-sequenced (EN1 cluster 12), matched secondary strata fall under the floor, so depth remains an alternative explanation for the identity-module differences. Cd177 UMI distribution in positives is spread 1-53 without a natural break; no bimodality claim. Co-detection null at 1,000 UMIs is uninformative (0 observed, ~0 expected).
EN6: simulator audit run (trials/continuation/EN6/). Three implementations x 3 parameter blocks x times x 2 seeds, 100 x 1,000 clones. Gillespie validated against the analytic one-lineage birth-death law (P0 error <=0.0013, conditional CCDF error <=0.007). q=0.5 blocks (Confetti, Red2Kras YFP): literal and fixed-branch identical (KS 0); literal vs Gillespie KS <=0.025 (Confetti) and 0.05-0.10 (YFP 14/28 d), i.e. horizon-overshoot and old-rate-across-tau effects are modest. Red2Kras RFP (q=0.7): the CA1 branch typo dominates: literal vs fixed-branch KS 0.10/0.28/0.28 at 1/2/4 weeks; fraction of clones with size>=2 is 0.91-0.96 (literal) vs 0.57-0.59 (fixed) vs 0.50-0.55 (Gillespie) because slow-population loss never fires; conditional mean size 66 vs 80 at 2 weeks, P90 66 vs 36. fixed-branch vs Gillespie KS <=0.045. Seed-to-seed KS <=0.011. Batch1 LOMO: kras mixture components are separated (fast p 0.001-0.005, weight 0.22-0.34, no overlap) while Confetti mixture weights range 0.09-0.89 across held-out mice with overlapping components (not identifiable). Code observation quantified; which implementation produced the published RFP curves is not established; merger/segmentation not modelled; EN6c spatial joint analysis stays blocked (no IDs).
EN7: external transfer run (trials/continuation/EN7/). Cd177 primary contrast unavailable in every unit: Choi day-14 has 117 transition-gated cells with 2 Cd177>=1; day-28 21/1; PBS 0; Niethamer day 0/11/25 samples hold 1-50 transition-gated cells with 0-1 Cd177>=1. Whole-unit pseudobulks: transient repair rise of cycling (+2.8 Choi d14-PBS; +3.7 Niethamer d11-d0, 2x2 agree), transition RNA (+2.1; +3.0, agree), shared disjoint module (+1.1; +1.4, agree), lesion disjoint module (+0.35; +0.39, agree) and Itga2 (+0.55; +2.8, agree), all reversing by d28/d25; Cd177 rises transiently in Choi (+2.0 then -1.7) but not consistently in Niethamer (-0.33, directions disagree); TNFA/NF-kB disjoint response ~0; Nfkbia lower at peak repair. Independent gates vs author labels: transition gate captures 10% of Choi DATP (88/880) and 27% of Niethamer Alveolar_transitional (62/229); AT1 gate is specific where AT1 exist (Niethamer AT1 1677/1759) but 'mixed' covers 15% of Choi hAT2 and 52% of Niethamer AT2. Descriptive transfer; single pooled libraries (Choi) or 2 animals per day (Niethamer); no injury-cancer axis.

EN1_state_reliability_notes: Transition gate is cluster-concentrated: 88% (Exp1) and 96% (Exp2) of transition-gated cells fall in two clusters. The main transition cluster is 98% mutant RFP in Exp1 (cluster 11) and holds 79% of Exp1 mutant transition cells; in Exp2 cluster 15 holds 90% of mutant transition cells.

AT1 gate (>=2 of Ager/Hopx/Clic5) is not cluster-concentrated. In Exp1 the largest AT2 clusters (0, 1, 9) have 17-18% AT1-gate cells; in Exp2 the AT2 clusters (7, 4, 0, 6, 11) have 29-43%. Top-2 clusters hold only 43% (Exp1) / 51% (Exp2) of AT1-gate cells. 'mixed' state largely reflects low-level Ager/Hopx detection in AT2 cells, not a mature AT1 population; no distinct AT1 cluster exists in these sorted libraries.

Cd177-positive cells concentrate in one high-depth cluster per experiment (Exp1 cluster 12: 96% 2-week mutant RFP, 21% Cd177>=1, 51% AT1 gate, 25% cycling>=2; Exp2 cluster 11: 13% Cd177>=1, 43% AT1 gate, 21% cycling).

Immune clusters retain 30-56% of cells under the primary rule (Exp1 clusters 6/7); strict rule removes more. Depth differs strongly across clusters (median UMIs 3.3k-13.8k); depth-thinned variants are essential for EN2-EN5.
